newsitem.title: USA: Conseco Q4 oper net up on acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Conseco Q4 oper net up on acquisitions.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Tuesday operating income rose in the fourth quarter ended December 31 beacuse of three factors, including recent acquisitons.

The company said its purchase of Life Partners Group in August of 1996, its increased ownership of Bankers Life Holding Corp and American Life Holdings and overall increased business were all factors in the improved results.
Conseco reported operating income of $85.7 million, or $0.54 a share, compared to $42.0 million, or $0.40 a share, in the same period one year ago.
Conseco is a financial services provider.
Its shares were trading down 3/4 Tuesday at 41-1/8.
